{{Quote|This cantina is the best place to gather information about what's going on in this city.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mercious Bragg]]|<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Tap the Communications of the Four Major Criminal Groups|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Theed Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
{{Quote|Report to Sergeant Mercious Bragg of the RSF Intelligence Division. You'll find him in the cantina.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Harvin Franchels]]|<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RSF]] [[RSF Intelligence Division|Intelligence]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mercious Bragg|Bragg]] used to spend some time in the cantina to collect information about local criminals.<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" />
